lead: A new `nvs_ir::Helper` variant is four edits and the fourth one is not a `match`.
body: Three are exhaustive matches the compiler makes you write — the variant, `nvs-ir`'s `print.rs` name and `nvs-codegen`'s symbol name — and the fourth is a row in `nvs_runtime::helpers::symbols()`, a hand-kept `Vec` nothing checks; miss it and everything builds and passes until the first program reaching the helper dies inside `cranelift-jit` with *"can't resolve symbol nvs_your_helper"*. Grep the symbol name you just added and expect **three** hits outside the runtime's own definition.
